THE TECH

THE PLATE

A full-length carbon plate runs heel to toe under the midsole. It is the spring in every stride, tuned for propulsion rather than stiffness for its own sake.

THE FOAM

Nitrogen-infused foam carries the plate. Soft on landing, quick to give the energy back, and light enough that the shoe disappears by kilometre two.

THE UPPER

One-piece engineered mesh, the red you see broken into glass above. It holds the midfoot locked and lets the toes splay on toe-off.
